reviews.text: Always so friendly and our dog loves going here.

my dog loves going to The Uptown Dog. everyone is so friendly and they treat her as if she is their own pup. we are always complimented and asked where she gets groomed cause she always looks absolutely stunning after her visits.

Really happy with Norman’s teeth cleaning! The team were lovely, caring and very flexible, especially as Norman has Addison’s disease. They took the time to listen to his medical needs and discuss how best to adapt the treatment to keep him comfortable and safe. It’s reassuring to know he’s in such caring hands. Highly recommend!
The only place I trust with my long haired mini dachshund! They take great care of him and he always leaves looking so perfect 🥹
My dog Mew always has a great experience here. The owner is so lovely and helpful, and the staff do a good job with his groom.
By far the best groomers in Greenwich. Lucia works magic on Teddy!! Such a treat! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

I have just come back from our first visit to Uptown dog Mickey looked after Alfie and what a beautiful job she did. Thank you so much Mickey I would recommend anybody to use their service. They were brilliant with him today.

Axel always goes in smelling like eggs and comes out smelling fresh. Demi’s great,
she must have the patience of a saint to get him to stand still!

Honestly, I can't thank these ladies enough for their patience and kindness! A few months ago my dog HATED having his nails trimmed, now...we tolerate it a LOT better and it's over with so quickly! Lucia has been amazing with him! Their shop is so beautiful with some yummy treats and lots of lovely accessories! Next step for my boy to overcome is a groom! Thanks again everyone! <3

We brought our 14month old Labrador for his first grooming session. The team were so kind and professional, putting him at ease. He came out the other end with a super soft and shiny coat and a big smile on his end. Would highly recommend

First full groom and it turned out exactly how I pictured it. So glad to hear that the puppy did well even with the blow dryer. She looks like a whole new pup and has been enjoying all the extra attention with her new style✨🎀 …
Lovely shopping experience. The gentleman on the desk was so helpful and kind to our puppy Mila. Will definitely go back again

Came here to get my dog’s nails clipped. Kindest staff! My dog is blind, so she gets really nervous while having her nails clipped. The woman who did it knew exactly how to soothe her while clipping. She also managed to clip the nails fairly quickly while still taking a lot of care to make sure she didn’t get the quick. I’ll be back next month for another clipping :)

Words are not enough to describe how amazing Uptown Dog is: professional, friendly and caring with dogs. My puppy has been going since his puppy groom and always comes out being very happy. They recently had to change an appointment and one of the groomers came on her day off to help!!! Excellent in all aspects.

A lovely place to bring your pooch for grooming. The staff are wonderful and caring. My french bulldog has special requirements and they all made sure to be gentle with her when I sent her away for grooming. I got a very happy and clean dog and she smelled amazing!
They also sell treats, toys, and various things and I got her a pretty set of leash, harness, and bow.
You got yourselves a repeat customer! x

I brought my Samoyed/Japanese spitz for the first time here and couldn’t be more delighted with the results! This has been the best grooming she has ever had! The fur is so soft and the cut was perfect and no strong nasty smells! Absolutely recommend this place! Book early as I waited several weeks for the appointment but definitely worth it!!

I highly recommend The Uptown Dog, I had my working cocker spaniel groomed today, we had a great experience.  The staff were lovely, my dog looks and smells wonderful and had such a good time he didn't want to leave!
Thank you for my glow up Ellie, lots of love, licky kisses and belly rubs Nala xxx

I couldn’t be more pleased with the grooming Micky gave my Australian Shepherd, Blu. If you have a long-haired Shepherd, I highly recommend booking with her. She listened carefully to what we wanted, and Blu came back looking perfect.

Uptown Dog are a fantastic groomers, the staff and grooming team are so professional and they love dogs.

Our dog, a Cockerpoo, used to be quite nervous and stressed when going to other groomers but never since we took her to Uptown Dog. She gets a great friendly reception and of course a beautiful groom.
Cooper absolutely loves his grooming visits to Uptown Dog. Everyone makes so much fuss of him and lots of cuddles to make him feel relaxed. Lucia does an amazing job with his groom! Thank you!
We always bring Pip to be groomed here & she comes out very happy & beautifully trimmed!

Our two basset hounds have been coming here for their regular grooming sessions for about a year now, and the team there always do such a lovely job! The ladies give them lots of love and cuddles too, so we know they are well looked after and adored when we drop them off. Thanks so much!
Fabulous groomers, so lovely with my two nervous dogs. They get lots of cuddles & always look & smell gorgeous 😃 …
A lovely groom as always, just what we asked for. Thank you
Doris always looks SPECTACULAR after coming to the Uptown Dog. All the groomers are so lovely and so professional and kind to Doris too. We wouldn’t go anywhere else! X
Both of my dogs get groomed here and they always look gorgeous

I’ve been bringing my Cavapoo to uptown dog for over a year now, and he is groomed to perfection every single time. All of the staff are so friendly and loving, and Arthur’s groomer Demi gives him all the love and cuddles he needs to relax him into his groom. Both me and pup love coming here and I recommend to anyone who asks! Thank you again and again :-)
Always a great experience at Uptown Dog. Lucia has been grooming our dog for years and does a brilliant job, plus our dog always seems happy to see her!

I Called in the morning to see if my puppy could get booked in for a paws, nails, hygiene area and eye trim and got in the same afternoon which I really appreciated.
The ladies was friendly and welcoming and the shop is well stocked with high quality products and very cute.
Rocco was booked with Ellie who did amazing, she was calm and patient with a very nervous pup. I have booked him in with her for his first full groom and have no doubt she will do a great job. :)

Highly recommend !!☺️
My dog is always very happy and me too!!😊 …
We get Teddy groomed, nails clipped and teeth brushed here. Lucia and the staff are always so wonderful and do such a great job whilst taking great care of Teds.
Our eurasier is a regular client and he's always taken care of. He comes back looking and smelling much improved!
Love it here! They love and care for our dog so well!!! Definitely recommend

The best pet shop with treats and accessories for dogs. Very friendly, experienced, and professional staff. My dog Toby visited today for full grooming. Even though he is normally very anxious, the staff were absolutely amazing with him. Love you UPTOWN  DOG!!!
Lucia and the team did such a fantastic job. My golden retriever looks sharp and fresh. Would highly recommended. Lots of great treats in the shop too, especially sausages.
Very good with our nervous pup Sausage - he didn’t want to leave!
This was my puppy’s first groom and I was very nervous she’d take too much but she did an amazing job as you can see by the before and after photos!! 😅 …

I brought my Jack Russell, Archie, in for hand stripping, and I couldn’t be happier with the results! He came out looking like an absolute gentleman — such a handsome boy! His coat looks amazing, and you can really tell the groomer knows how to work with wire-haired breeds. The team was professional, friendly, and clearly took great care of Archie. Highly recommend this salon if you’re looking for quality grooming and a personal touch. We’ll definitely be back!
Sushi is normally quite upset when I leave her with someone. On her second visit here she separated without any fuss and whining, which means she must like it there!

Highly recommend The Uptown Dog for your dog grooming needs. Everyone is incredibly friendly and skilled and the salon is beautiful. Lucia has been grooming my senior Maltese Benny for a few months now and is absolutely amazing with him. She is so genuinely caring and loving with him, and really puts him at ease. Never before has he been so at ease going to the groomer. She does an incredible job, and I look forward to it every month!
Really please with our dogs' groom. The team at uptown dog was very professional and our dog had a good experience.

I am so impressed and genuinely blown away by The Uptown Dog.

I have a 7-month-old puppy and didn’t choose them as our first groomer due to the distance, and I’d heard they can book up quickly and are on the pricier side. However, after our experience, I truly believe they are worth every penny—and then some.

My puppy had a traumatic experience with another groomer and was left fearful and anxious. The team at The Uptown Dog welcomed us with open arms. Before our first visit, they even spent time on a long phone consultation to talk through everything and answer my questions with compassion and care. I was encouraged by our dog trainer to bring her into the store multiple times a week for nearly a month just to get her comfortable with the environment. Each time, the groomers took the time to greet her warmly, offer treats, and help make the space feel safe and positive.

About two weeks ago, we did a trial visit where my pup was simply placed on the grooming table for a gentle brushing—nothing more—just so she could learn that it’s a safe space. Today, we finally did the full groom, and I’m thrilled to say it went wonderfully. The team said she did great, which was especially meaningful after our previous groomer said she was “too aggressive” to finish. When I picked her up, she wasn’t overly stressed or shut down—just happy and beautiful.

I’m beyond grateful for the time, patience, and kindness they’ve shown. The groomer took such gentle, thoughtful care of my girl, and I truly can’t thank them enough. If you’re on the fence, don’t hesitate—The Uptown Dog is exceptional and obviously love the dogs they work with.
